title: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI + uv + ruff)

commands.lint: uv run ruff check . --fix && uv run ruff format .

summary: Python 3.12+, FastAPI, Pydantic v2, SQLAlchemy 2.0 (Async), uv, ruff
rules: Always run tooling via uv run. Never execute bare pip or unmanaged python.
Use native Python 3.10+ union types (int | None, list[str]). Avoid Any.
All endpoint request and response bodies must have explicit Pydantic v2 schemas.
Enforce layered architecture: Router -> Service -> Repository. Never make direct DB calls in routers.
Async endpoints must use SQLAlchemy 2.0 async sessions. Never call blocking sync functions in async def.
